name: Dont Be Late For School! 🚌
desc:
🏫 Welcome to the morning rush — grab your backpack and join the queue for school!
🚌 Find your seat on the bus, hold on tight, and get ready for the ride.
🏃‍♂️ Sprint all the way to first period and see what awaits when the bell rings!
📚 Replay your morning commute to unlock and visit even more chaotic classrooms around the campus.
Will you make it to your next class on time? 👀

llm.loop: queue for school -> ride the bus -> sprint to class -> experience chaotic classroom events -> replay to unlock more classrooms
llm.objectives: make it to class on time and unlock more chaotic classrooms
llm.instructions: join the queue, find a seat on the bus, sprint to first period, replay to visit more classrooms
unique: paid trolling products (kill all, scare all, be teacher, ban hammer)
llm.thumbnails: yellow school bus icon; avatar running after a school bus
llm.complexity_notes: scripted short experience with bus ride and classroom scenes; unclear how deep the classroom events are
